## Live replacement

**Live file swap: static only.** Builds cold-boot. A GC savestate caches the old FST, so a state replayed on a modded disc reads old slots for relocated files; the private face proof installed the new disc's same-length FST first. No production hot path; CP13 untested.

**Pick whip: partial.** pso_face inspect lists resident face textures for a chosen class (no auto class/head detection); entity table names objects; the GC profile has no camera, so no screen point -> entity and no GC route in pick_replace.

**Live controls:** pso_mods / pso_live session ops (give, floor_spawn, equip_any, survival, revive, mag, stat, always_hit, boss_warp, autoplay_speed...) via the dispatcher, Plus rev 2 only, proven (pso-survival-mag/accuracy receipts); pso_face op=inspect\|apply\|restore live face paint.

## Gaps before a live swap / pick whip

- No pso_gc_swap build has been booted in Dolphin; P7a rigging for GC (gvr_chunk, BE tree, flat names) sits on unmerged branches e84af16c/8090217d/e1abfc4b
- Hot swap (CP13): the loaded player model's RAM location / actor model pointer is not found; area-change reload from disc untested
- No camera mapping in profiles/pso-gc-plus-us.json, so pickwhip cannot project entities to the screen
- Live addresses are for Plus rev 2 PsoV3.dol only; Ep I&II USA and Return To Ragol executables need re-derivation
- No savestate/jump state in the lane: every launch cold-boots (~10 min per verify round); city->floor gate is code (P1 open)
